method: Direct PyMuPDF vector extraction and numbered-label containment; numbered directory names match coverage IDs. No coordinate inference from the older technical plate.
extraction_precision_note: Values rounded to 0.001 m from PDF vectors; precision is not architectural survey accuracy. Near-integer rounding such as 431.999 m is retained in extracted markers.

calibration.axes: X port negative/starboard positive; Z bow negative/aft positive; Y deck height

door_marker.interpretation: Historical symbolic door center only; marker size is not clear opening, swing or pocket.
